## Lab tools

*Coming soon: audio analyser (oscilloscope, FFT spectrum, CSV export), accelerometer and gyroscope.*

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const clock = document.getElementById("tb-clock");
  const tickClock = () => { const d = new Date(); clock.textContent = pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ":" + pad(d.getSeconds()); };
  tickClock(); setInterval(tickClock, 1000);

  /* the timer preview counts down 60 s and starts over */
  const ring = document.getElementById("tb-ring"), txt = document.getElementById("tb-timer");
  let left = 60;
  const tickTimer = () => {
    txt.textContent = pad(Math.floor(left / 60)) + ":" + pad(left % 60);
    ring.style.setProperty("--p", (left / 60 * 100) + "%");
    left = left <= 0 ? 60 : left - 1;
  };
  tickTimer(); setInterval(tickTimer, 1000);
})();
</script>
```
